jobs.description:
Brief Description

ROLE SUMMARY

The Project Coordinator, Market Execution works under the direction of the Project Manager to support execution across market and business priorities spanning product, operations, supply chain, compliance, marketing, sales, and external partners. This role supports work after a market or product decision has been made. Market evaluation, licensing, and partner agreements before that decision are supported by the Project Coordinator, Expansion.

This role keeps internal work moving by maintaining project plans and timelines, tracking deliverables, following up with owners, keeping documentation current, and surfacing risks or blockers early. The goal is to keep projects organized, visible, and moving without dropped handoffs or unclear next steps.

What You’ll Do

Project Execution & Tracking

Maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, owners, dependencies, and deliverables
Track work from kickoff through completion and keep project information current
Follow up with internal owners on outstanding deliverables and action items
Identify missed deadlines, bottlenecks, dependencies, and risks early
Escalate blockers or decisions needed to the Project Manager
Support multiple projects and market workstreams simultaneously as assigned by the Project Manager

Cross-Functional Coordination

Track work across the internal teams the Project Manager runs projects with: product, operations, marketing, sales, compliance, and external partners
Track cross-functional dependencies and ensure required inputs and deliverables stay moving
Capture decisions, owners, and next steps and follow through until actions are closed
Flag gaps between teams before they impact timelines or execution

Communication & Visibility

Maintain accurate project boards, trackers, and documentation
Prepare clear status updates covering progress, milestones, risks, and outstanding actions
Keep boards and status current so the Project Manager can keep stakeholders and leadership informed; communicate day-to-day changes directly to task owners
Surface risks and delays early so they can be addressed before they escalate

Market Execution Support

Support execution across product launches, commercialization, and in-market initiatives assigned by the Project Manager
Maintain project documentation, approvals, trackers, and version history as needed
Coordinate internal meetings, reviews, samples, approvals, and other activities required to move projects forward (schedules and tracks approvals; does not grant them)
Support launch-readiness and execution checklists across relevant functions
Receive the handoff from the Expansion team once a market decision is made, and build the launch tracker from the Expansion team’s plan and open items

Systems & Process

Maintain project boards in Asana or other project management systems
Build out and maintain the trackers, templates, and workflows defined by the Project Manager
Keep project structures organized, current, and easy for teams to use
Identify recurring execution gaps and surface opportunities for process improvement
Document the repeatable ways of working the Project Manager defines as the function grows

WORKING WITH THE EXPANSION TEAM

Mfused has two Project Coordinators. Both use Asana and both work across teams. The lines below keep the work from being tracked twice.

The go decision is the dividing line. The Project Coordinator, Expansion (reporting to the Expansion lead) supports everything before Mfused commits to a market: market research, market selection, licensing, ownership and partner agreements, and contract review. The Project Coordinator, Market Execution supports everything after: product, production, launch, commercialization, and in-market initiatives.
One portfolio per market. Each new market gets a single Asana portfolio with a named handoff milestone ("Go decision / handoff to Market Execution"). Expansion owns the portfolio up to that milestone; Market Execution owns it after. There is never a second tracker for the same market.
Gray areas go up, not sideways. If it is unclear which lane a piece of work belongs in, the Project Manager, Market Execution and the Expansion lead decide. Coordinators do not negotiate scope with each other.
Cross-lane visibility. Each coordinator is a follower on the other’s portfolio so both can see status, but only the owning coordinator updates it.

What You Bring

1+ years supporting projects in a fast-moving environment (coordinator, analyst, operations, or similar)
Experience maintaining project plans, timelines, and trackers for multiple projects at once
Hands-on use of Asana or a similar project management tool, and strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel
Comfortable following up with people at every level until an action is closed
Clear, direct written communication; status updates that are short and useful
High attention to detail and follow-through; nothing falls through the cracks
Experience in cannabis, regulated industries, manufacturing, or multi-state operations is a plus

THE ENVIRONMENT

Mfused is a performance environment. Priorities shift. Markets evolve. Execution still happens. This role is built for someone who keeps things organized when others don’t, follows up without being asked twice, and communicates before issues escalate.

What You Get In Return

High standards deserve real support. Mfused invests in benefits, resources, and experiences that allow team members to sustain performance and take care of their lives outside of work. Depending on eligibility, this may include:

Medical insurance options
401(k) matching
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Phone stipends for qualified roles
Paid company holidays, PTO, and sick leave
Company events including holiday parties and summer events

Benefits may vary by role, location, and employment status.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Onsite at our Scottsdale, AZ office, Monday through Friday, with occasional evening or weekend work to meet business needs
Regular interaction with manufacturing and operational environments
Extended periods of sitting, standing, and computer use
Occasional travel to operational, office, or manufacturing sites

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

About Mfused

MFUSED is a minority-owned and operated cannabis company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with operations across multiple U.S. markets and internationally. We operate in one of the most regulated and competitive industries in the country. The expectation is simple: build high-quality products, execute at a high level, and continue raising the standard.

COMPLIANCE & LEGAL

Hiring is contingent on successful completion of a background check

One portfolio per market. Each new market gets a single Asana portfolio with a named handoff milestone ("Go decision / handoff to Market Execution"). Expansion owns the portfolio up to that milestone; Market Execution owns it after. There is never a second tracker for the same market.
Gray areas go up, not sideways. If it is unclear which lane a piece of work belongs in, the Project Manager, Market Execution and the Expansion lead decide. Coordinators do not negotiate scope with each other.
Cross-lane visibility. Each coordinator is a follower on the other’s portfolio so both can see status, but only the owning coordinator updates it.

Experience in cannabis, regulated industries, manufacturing, or multi-state operations is a plus
